name: agentlens-blog-feed
title: 博客源
description: Use this skill when the user or another skill/prompt needs the latest AgentLens blogs that have not been seen before. It discovers newly published blogs from the AgentLens public API, fetches each new blog's body, and tracks processed blogs in a local memory file so every blog surfaces exactly once. It only fetches and de-duplicates — deciding what to do with each new blog (summarize, draft posts, translate, save) is left to the caller.
